Jane Peacock (EmployeeId 3) is the sales support agent whose customers generated the most revenue: $833.04 in invoice totals. Her customers: 21 distinct customers and 146 invoices.

For comparison, the other Sales Support Agents are:
- Margaret Park (EmployeeId 4): $775.40 from 20 customers and 140 invoices

Notes: revenue figures are the sum of Invoice.Total for customers assigned to each support rep.
sql_used:
SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS Name, e.Title, IFNULL(SUM(i.Total),0) AS Revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerId) AS CustomerCount, COUNT(i.InvoiceId) AS InvoiceCount
FROM Employee e
LEFT JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId
LEFT JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
WHERE e.Title = 'Sales Support Agent'
GROUP BY e.EmployeeId
ORDER BY Revenue DESC;
assumptions: "Sales support agent" was identified by Employee.Title = 'Sales Support Agent'.
Revenue per agent is defined as the sum of Invoice.Total for invoices belonging to customers whose Customer.SupportRepId equals that employee's EmployeeId.
